build_prompt_from_style: build a prompt by inserting a text snippet into a story generation style template
run_all_story_styles: run the script to build prompts for all three story styles and push to hub
run_single_story_style: run the script with a specific generation style like problem_solving_story or reddit_post
customize_repo_id: run the script with a custom HuggingFace repo ID for the output dataset
review_styles_dict: review the STYLES dictionary containing young_children_story, problem_solving_story, and reddit_post prompt templates
